phases.objective: Create a short-lived, one-shot, tamper-evident authorization packet that binds durable bridge readiness and fixed dispatch certification without persisting or executing the mount.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Separate Mount Authorization Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Verified bridge readiness plus verified fixed dispatch certification and exact runtime, database, route, plan, lease, approval, capability, policy, and rollback bindings produce a short-lived single-use authorization packet ready only for a later mount executor.
steps: Independently verify the durable bridge readiness packet and digest.
Independently verify the fixed dispatch certificate and nested worker certificate.
Require exact source/deployed SHA parity, database fingerprint, schema verification, and readback cycle.
Bind the Tenant route seam, dependency key, target, operation, plan, and execution lease.
Bind approval set, capability envelope, mount policy, rollback plan, issuer, revision, and generation.
Require approved, single-use, unconsumed, default-off authorization with at most one-hour lifetime.
Recompute nested blockers and the authorization digest during independent verification.
assertions: A tampered or not-ready bridge or dispatch certificate cannot authorize mounting.
The Tenant route remains fail-closed and unmounted.
The authorization is created only as a packet; it is not persisted or consumed.
No dependency is injected, no worker is mounted, no job is enqueued, and no credential or provider is accessed.
The successful terminal is ready_for_authorized_mount_execution, not mount_performed.
Provider dispatch and Production readiness remain false.

phases.objective: Persist and consume the authorization only inside a separately reviewed mount executor.
blockers: No authorization registry write or one-shot consumption occurs in this slice.
No canonical runtime factory or route dependency injection occurs.

phases.objective: Prove mount rollback, restart reconciliation, authorization expiry, and one-shot replay rejection after a mount executor exists.
blockers: Runtime/provider parity has not been established.

phases.objective: This repository-only authorization slice performs no live route, worker, provider, SSH, database, or Hostinger canary.
Authorization persistence, mount execution, dispatch, deployment, and Production remain separately governed.
